content.user_title: Mine Paid Search Terms Into Actions
content.value_statement: Paid search teams waste budget when search-term exports are not reviewed on a cadence. This skill turns exports into keyword adds, negative keywords, n-gram waste findings, and a handoff summary.
actual_capabilities: Reviews search-terms exports that include query, cost, clicks, impressions, conversions, and optional conversion value.
Identifies converting queries that should become new keywords or move into stronger ad groups.
Builds negative-keyword recommendations from queries with meaningful spend and zero conversions.
Creates an n-gram waste report that ranks spend-draining tokens across non-converting queries.
Scores the ROAS Spend-efficiency dimension with measured, user-provided, or estimated labels.
Produces a maintenance diff and standard handoff summary for the next paid ads skill.
limitations: Requires a pasted or exported search-terms report with cost and conversion columns.
Does not redesign account structure, allocate budget, or compute the final RQS score.
Does not change live ad accounts without user review and confirmation.
Keyed ad-platform APIs are optional connector conveniences, not required behavior.

use_cases.title: Clean Monthly Search Terms
use_cases.description: Turn a monthly export into adds, negatives, moves, and a measured waste summary.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Optimization Notes
use_cases.description: Convert raw query rows into a clear maintenance diff and rationale for approval.

use_cases.title: Find Wasted Startup Spend
use_cases.description: Identify costly non-converting query themes before increasing paid search budget.

prompt_templates.title: Mine a Basic Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one search-terms file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this paid search-terms export. Goal is direct response. Use cost and conversions to recommend adds, negatives, and moves.

prompt_templates.title: Build Negative Keywords
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused waste cleanup for non-converting queries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a negative-keyword list from this export. Use a clear cost floor, state match types, and separate campaign-level from ad-group negatives.

prompt_templates.title: Harvest Converting Queries
prompt_templates.scenario: Promote search terms that show demand.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these search terms and existing keywords. Show which converting queries should be added, moved, or grouped into new intent themes.

prompt_templates.title: Run Maintenance Diff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recurring optimization with handoff notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full search-term mining loop for this account export. Use my thresholds, build an n-gram waste report, score ROAS S, and prepare the handoff summary.

output_examples.input: A search-terms export with query, cost, conversions, and conversion value.
output_examples.output: A maintenance diff that lists keyword adds, negative keywords, moved queries, cost evidence, and approval notes.

output_examples.input: A report where many high-cost queries have zero conversions.
output_examples.output: An n-gram waste report that ranks recurring tokens by measured cost and recommends safe negative match types.

output_examples.input: A recurring weekly paid search review request.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of harvested demand, wasted spend, ROAS Spend-efficiency notes, and the next recommended skill.

best_practices: Use fresh exports that include query, cost, conversions, and conversion value when available.
Set harvest thresholds and waste cost floors before reviewing recommendations.
Review broad negative themes before adding them to a shared list.
anti_patterns: Negating terms based on clicks alone without checking conversions or cost.
Using this skill to redesign campaign structure or decide budget allocation.
Applying recommendations directly to live accounts without marketer approval.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs search terms, cost, conversions, and preferably clicks, impressions, and conversion value.

faq.question: Can it use Google Ads exports?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for native ad-manager search-terms exports, including Google Ads reports.

faq.question: Does it update campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares recommendations and saves results only after user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it replace campaign planning?
faq.answer: No. It handles recurring search-term mining, not account structure or budget strategy.

faq.question: How does it find wasted spend?
faq.answer: It groups non-converting queries into tokens and ranks them by measured cost.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code hosts.
